description: Read one web page as Markdown: url, HTTP status, title, markdown, token estimate and content hash. One http(s) URL per call. Not charged if the page fails. Caller is responsible for the target site's terms. robots.txt is respected. ?url=https://...&max_chars=20000 Use when: you need one web page as clean Markdown for an LLM or RAG pipeline. Don't use when: you need many pages from one site (use /v1/crawl), or the page needs a login or sits behind a paywall. Price: $0.02 per call over x402 (USDC on Base). Set sample:true for a sample at no charge.

max_chars.description: Max characters of Markdown to return, 1-100000 (default 20000)

sample.description: true: return the sample at no charge (no payment, other arguments ignored)

url.description: One http(s) page URL (required). No commas or lists.
